measurement: Actual final release EXE, isolated hidden WebView2 profile. Three alternating trials per mode and original capture; single-frame times exclude engine initialization. The old mode disables only fog references. First old 20032 frame includes lazy loading of 23 references. Additional correctness cases ran after the benchmarks.
limitations: The four user-labelled 1080p captures are both reference-building samples and regression inputs, not independent holdout captures.
720p, 900p, 1440p, 4K, pan and UI variants are generated from these same captures.
The 31 synthesized game-map views test false positives in the new shortcut, not overall accuracy of full-search fallback. Existing weak-preview ambiguity remains.
Default farthest zoom and reliable side-door evidence are required by the fog shortcut; uncertainty uses the existing search.
No live M-key-to-result timing or all-dungeon real-fog accuracy claim.
